# FlareRichTextEditor

`Flare.Components.FlareRichTextEditor`

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Label` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Accessible label for the editor content area. |
| `MinHeight` | `string` | `"150px"` | Parameter |  | Minimum CSS height of the editable content area. |
| `Placeholder` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Placeholder text shown when the editor is empty. Defaults to the localized "RTE_Placeholder" string. |
| `ReadOnly` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Disables editing; content is displayed read-only. |
| `Sanitize` | `bool` | `true` | Parameter |  | Whether Value and pasted markup are filtered before being shown. true by default: an editor whose value survives a round trip through storage is exactly where a script smuggled into the markup would be executed again on every later view. Turning it off is a statement that the markup is trusted, and it is the caller's to make - not a convenience. The editor's own formatting never needs it: everything the toolbar produces is inside the allowlist. |
| `ShowHeadings` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Shows H1/H2/H3 heading buttons in the toolbar. |
| `ShowLink` | `bool` | `false` | Parameter |  | Shows a link-insertion button in the toolbar. |
| `Value` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | HTML string representing the current editor content, and the editor's security boundary. Whatever is bound here - a stored draft, a server response, a value round-tripped through a database - is treated as untrusted and filtered against an allowlist before it reaches the page: formatting, lists, headings, quotes, links and images survive, scripts and event handlers do not. Pasted markup goes through the same filter. Set Sanitize to false only for markup the application itself produced and has not let a user near. The filtering happens in the browser, on the parsed tree, using the platform's own sanitizer where the engine has one. That is deliberate: a filter applied to the string in .NET is guessing at the tree a browser will build from it, and browsers repair malformed markup in ways no pattern predicts. |
| `ValueChanged` | `EventCallback<string>` | `` | Callback |  | Callback raised when the editor content changes. |
| `AdditionalAttributes` | `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object>?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional attributes. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
| `Class` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Additional CSS class(es) appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
| `Style` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Inline style string appended to the component's root element. Inherited from `FlareComponentBase`. |
